description: This file defines the high-level API for the rate control module in Realtek RTL8367/RTL8367C switches, including data types, constants, and function declarations for configuring and querying meter and bandwidth control settings.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_set
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a shared meter, including rate and whether IFG is included.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a shared meter, including type, rate, and IFG inclusion.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_set
methods.description: Sets the bucket size for a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_get
methods.description: Gets the bucket size of a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets ingress port bandwidth control parameters, including rate, IFG inclusion, and flow control.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets ingress port bandwidth control parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets egress port bandwidth control parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets egress port bandwidth control parameters.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables bandwidth control on a specific egress queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves bandwidth control enable status for a specific egress queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets the shared meter index controlling egress queue bandwidth.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets the shared meter index controlling egress queue bandwidth.
